mapper.sql: r.id AS `cursor`, r.payment_no AS paymentNo, r.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.member_id AS memberId, r.status AS status, r.expected_amount AS expectedAmount, r.currency AS currency, r.active_attempt_no AS activeAttemptNo, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt, r.version AS version, s.receipt_no AS succeededReceiptNo, r.close_fence_at AS closeFenceAt, r.business_no AS businessNo
FROM tc_payment_intent r JOIN tc_order o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.id=r.order_id LEFT JOIN tc_payment_receipt s ON s.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND s.id=r.succeeded_receipt_id AND s.intent_id=r.id
